meaning.en: (organic chemistry) A bitter glycoside ((5R-trans)-5-ethenyl-6-(b-D-glucopyranosyloxy)-5,6-dihydro-1H,3H-pyrano[3,4-c]pyran-1-one) found in gentians.
meaning.vi: (hóa học hữu cơ) Một glycoside đắng ((5R-trans) -5-ethenyl-6- (bD-glucopyranosyloxy) -5,6-dihydro-1H, 3H-pyrano [3,4-c] pyran-1-one) tìm thấy ở gentians.
